event_id.description: Unique identifier for each simulated event

primary_particle_pdg.description: PDG code of the primary particle

primary_particle_ke.description: Initial kinetic energy of the primary particle in MeV

primary_particle_px.description: Initial x-component of the primary particle momentum vector

primary_particle_py.description: Initial y-component of the primary particle momentum vector

primary_particle_pz.description: Initial z-component of the primary particle momentum vector

primary_vertex_x.description: x-coordinate of the primary particle's starting position in mm

primary_vertex_y.description: y-coordinate of the primary particle's starting position in mm

primary_vertex_z.description: z-coordinate of the primary particle's starting position in mm

total_energy_deposition.description: Total energy deposited in all scintillator slabs in MeV

slab1_energy.description: Energy deposited in the first scintillator slab in MeV

slab2_energy.description: Energy deposited in the second scintillator slab in MeV

slab3_energy.description: Energy deposited in the third scintillator slab in MeV

slab4_energy.description: Energy deposited in the fourth scintillator slab in MeV

hit_count.description: Total number of detector hits in all slabs

hit_position_x.description: Array of x-coordinates of detector hits in mm

hit_position_y.description: Array of y-coordinates of detector hits in mm

hit_position_z.description: Array of z-coordinates of detector hits in mm

hit_energy.description: Array of energy depositions for each hit in MeV

hit_time.description: Array of time of each hit in ns

secondary_particle_pdg.description: PDG codes of all unique secondary particles created in the event
